In detail

The most pronounced conflicting-evidence case found in this research, and both sides are disclosed rather than one being picked. The 2022 police breakdown grouped Wzgórza Krzesławickie with Mistrzejowice and Bieńczyce as one of the lowest-crime pairings citywide on raw theft counts. Yet the independent 2020 Otodom resident-perception survey (120,000+ respondents) rated it the single worst district in the entire city (3.20/5), with a specifically alarming children's-safety subscore of just 2.74/5 — the weakest individual figure recorded anywhere in that survey. Given the severity and specificity of that children's-safety finding in a large-sample survey, and that a night-time/evening safety concern is exactly what a low overall perception score of this kind tends to track, the night rating here follows the perception data rather than the raw grouped theft count. Sources checked: Portal Samorządowy (2022 police district data); Otodom District Ranking 2020.
